question: Should OpenClaw land this as the combined `includeFamily` plus default-off `sessionFamilyCarryover` path, or require the base family-history PR to land first and rebase this PR down to carryover-only?
rationale: The code appears mechanically sound, but it adds a model-facing history selector and an opt-in provider-boundary path for archived reset summaries; automation should not decide that product/security contract or stack order.

options.title: Land base first, then rebase carryover
options.body: Merge or replace the base family-history retrieval work first, then review this PR as the smaller default-off carryover layer.

options.title: Accept the combined branch
options.body: Treat this PR as the combined landing path and explicitly accept that the selector, config surface, and carryover behavior ship together.

options.title: Pause carryover
options.body: Keep family retrieval moving but defer prompt-boundary carryover until maintainers are ready to approve archived context exposure to providers.

recommendation.title: Land base first, then rebase carryover
recommendation.body: Merge or replace the base family-history retrieval work first, then review this PR as the smaller default-off carryover layer.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision combines product scope, provider-boundary privacy, and storage/session architecture concerns, and steipete is the most directly connected owner in the reviewed history and thread routing.
